pack.title: Setting boundaries early
pack.description: New-dating pressure tests. Clear early beats resentful later.

scenarios.setting: Third date. You say you have an early morning; they order another round.
scenarios.jab: Oh come on, one more. Don't be boring.

replies.line: I'm good — and boring is underrated. See you next week.
replies.why: It accepts the teasing label while stating your own plan to leave.
replies.delivery: Put your things together, say the boundary clearly, then leave if you choose.

replies.why: It skips the debate entirely — leaving is the boundary, stated once.
replies.delivery: Put your things together, say the boundary clearly, then leave if you choose.

replies.line: I've enjoyed tonight; I'm heading home because I want to rest.
replies.why: It expresses genuine enjoyment without making the refusal conditional on future plans.
replies.delivery: Put your things together, say the boundary clearly, then leave if you choose.

replies.line: Boring people need sleep too. It's in the handbook.
replies.why: It uses light humor about your own bedtime while declining another drink.
replies.delivery: Put your things together, say the boundary clearly, then leave if you choose.

trap.line: Fine, ONE more, but you're annoying.
trap.why: It replaces a specific request with accusation, resentment, or an excuse, making your actual boundary less clear.

scenarios.goal: Leave when you want despite pressure to stay.

followUp.line: I'm finished for tonight; take care.
followUp.why: It repeats the decision without negotiating another drink.
followUp.delivery: Put your things together, say the boundary clearly, then leave if you choose.

scenarios.setting: Two weeks in. They want your location shared, always.
scenarios.jab: If you have nothing to hide, just share your location. Everyone does it.

replies.line: I don't share my location. Privacy matters to me.
replies.why: It states a privacy choice without promising eventual access.
replies.delivery: Pause, then say “I don't share my location” at a steady, conversational volume. ” with no laugh that makes the answer sound negotiable.

replies.why: It makes the decision clear without a negotiable timeline.
replies.delivery: Stress “not sharing,” with no laugh that makes the answer sound negotiable.

replies.line: I like getting to know you; I still want to keep my location private.
replies.why: It makes affection compatible with personal privacy.
replies.delivery: Keep “I like getting to know you” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. ” with no laugh that makes the answer sound negotiable.

replies.line: My location isn't joining the group chat.
replies.why: Light humor declines sharing without implying they will earn access later.
replies.delivery: Keep “My location isn't joining the group chat” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. ” with no laugh that makes the answer sound negotiable.

scenarios.goal: Keep control of your location privacy.

followUp.jab: Couples should have nothing to hide.
followUp.line: Privacy matters to me; I'm not sharing my location.
followUp.why: It separates personal privacy from an accusation of secrecy.
followUp.delivery: Stress “not sharing,” with no laugh that makes the answer sound negotiable.
